services.name: Sip & Strolls
services.desc: 2026 Dates June 18, July 23, August 20, October 22 FAMILY FRIENDLY EVENT FOR ALL AGES! Sip & Stroll through the zoo at our family friendly happy hour series - June, July, August, and October. Each Sip will feature a local food vendor and live music, along with adult beverages, including craft beer and wine. Plus, our concession stand will be open with snacks and soft drinks. This family friendly event is fun for all ages! Limited number of tickets will be sold. Drink and food purchases sold separately. Drink tickets ($6) and silicone cups can be purchased at the ticket window or snack bar. 5:00pm-7:30pm

services.name: Sensory Hour
services.desc: Spring 2026 Dates Sunday, April 12th Saturday, May 16th Sunday, June 14th Enjoy the zoo for a quiet hour in the morning. Guests can experience the zoo with low crowds and sensory sensitive activity stations. This includes guests with sensory sensitivities, disabilities, autism, PTSD, and dementia. No age limit and the zoo will be open to anyone. The Zootique gift shop will be open, however the concessions stand will not be open until 10:00. Some animals may not be in their public view habitats. The zoo will open to the general public at 10am. Members are free and do not need to pre-register. 9:00am-10:00am

blurb: The Brandywine Zoo is located in Wilmington, Delaware, along the Brandywine River in Brandywine Park. It features animal exhibits including a new multi-species habitat called Hidden Falls with species impacted by habitat loss. The zoo hosts special events, educational programs, and birthday parties.
